original_card.acceptance_gate: A new physically realizable contract outside the frozen catalogue whose per-call profile, screened with ceiling.ceiling(), beats the selected word's packing ceiling; a lower cap does not establish identical circuitry or order attainable optima, and is insufficient to pass the stronger-budget target under this model.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin.

allowed_variations: Narrow to one changed boundary or helper type with explicit counts.

actual_scope: All-group two-register cost-preserving reduction with at most three nonmonomial scalar mixing blocks and a full group-diagonal endpoint.
scope_change_reason: A constructive noncommuting search reached PR288's open m=3, W=2 five-call question. The middle coefficient classes give a universal short-word pruning lemma. This negative result does not meet the positive supplier acceptance gate.
bottleneck_link: A five-call m=3 two-register supplier would change the complex primitive's paid profile. We exclude attempts with at most three scalar mixing blocks, including arbitrary interleaved free unary maps, and leave the four-block case open.
stop_rule: Publish the completed scoped lemma and exact controls; do not expand the five-call search without a new exact endpoint or concrete interface hypothesis.
